Doppler permutation: 354 distinct pair(s) across 26 scans
gravity null: max 14 candidate region(s) over 25 matched-noise replications
proposed_next_tests: add a measurement-status field distinguishing MEASURED runs from law-driven simulations at scan time
run a relative-kind EIT scan and record the metric contrast
repeat the gravity transect at several noise seeds and record flag-position spread
unresolved_questions: Does the EIT knee mark a regime boundary of the medium, or of the absolute metric? (a relative-kind scan flags uniformly)

Does the RLC coincidence record indicate a joint cause, or two independent single-factor stories?
Which of these law-driven curves has ever been checked against a measurement inside this lab? (none; all are Y-domain data)
